question.prompt: Define the operation \(\star\) by \(a\star b = (a+b)b.\) What is \((3\star 5)-(5\star 3)?\)

solutions.explanation:
In the definition, the multiplier is the second input, so evaluate each ordered pair separately:
\[
3\star5=(3+5)5=40,
\qquad
5\star3=(5+3)3=24.
\]
Therefore
\[
(3\star5)-(5\star3)=40-24=\boxed{16},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Apply the operation in each order
